company.name: 香港商捷比達有限公司台灣分公司

description.text:
Job Description
· Work with management and users to review business requirements and provide Salesforce solution and processes improvement
· Work closely with business development and account owners on business request, review account’s target, forecast, and revenue achievement
· Provide training and supports to management and business users
· Create and maintain analysis reports and dashboards to review sales activities and KPI's
· Handle the Salesforce administrative functions including system configuration and user account management
· Work with other team members and vendors on system integration and data exchange

key_values.label: 工作技能
key_values.text: 系統架構規劃、結構化程式設計、系統整合分析

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
Requirements
· BS or MS in Business, computer science or industrial engineering, or other relevant experience
· Familiar with Salesforce for Sales Cloud, system administration, configuration, customization and maintenance
· Good knowledge of sales processes and funnel management
· Good knowledge of the Project management
· Good analytical and troubleshooting skills
· Strong communication skills and fluent in English & Mandarin
· Technical skills in APEX programming and SQL
· Salesforce Administration certification is a plus
